title: 14-layer ZnS/ZnSe stack with LWIR quarter-wave initialization
scientific_hypothesis: Increasing layer count from 10 to 14 periods will strengthen MWIR stopband rejection through additional interference periods while maintaining LWIR passband transmittance, approaching the 16-layer manufacturing constraint limit.
design_principle: Quarter-wave stack design with optical thicknesses centered at 9500 nm (LWIR band center) for high-index/low-index alternating layers to create constructive interference in LWIR and destructive interference in MWIR.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | Ge substrate (14 finite layers total, alternating sequence starting with ZnS)
soft_objectives: Maximize average transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band
Minimize average transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds 500-2000 nm accommodate quarter-wave optical thickness at 9500 nm
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for dichroic filter design
expected_advantages: Maintained LWIR transmission through proper quarter-wave tuning
Approaches maximum allowable layer count for best stopband performance
known_risks: Material_data failures observed in previous 12-layer attempts may recur
Increased layer count may reduce robustness to thickness variations
Optimizer may require more iterations to converge with 14 variables
execution_request_english: Optimize a 14-layer alternating ZnS/ZnSe multilayer stack on Ge substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe (14 finite layers). Use coherent TMM solver. Initialize all layer thicknesses at quarter-wave optical thickness for 9500 nm center wavelength (approximately 1080 nm for ZnS n≈2.2, 990 nm for ZnSe n≈2.4). Set thickness bounds 500-2000 nm for all layers. Optimize for maximum transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band and minimum transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. Sample spectrum at 2001 points from 3000-11000 nm. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with learning rate 0.03. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Increased layer count from 10 to 14 to test whether additional periods improve MWIR suppression while staying within 16-layer manufacturing constraint. Changed from iteration_22's 10-layer topology.
